sloka: तस्मात् च यज्ञ आयतनात् पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च ।आनिन्युर् वानरा गत्वा सुग्रीव प्रिय कारणात् ॥४-३७-३२॥
transliteration: tasmāt ca yajña āyatanāt puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca ।āninyur vānarā gatvā sugrīva priya kāraṇāt ॥4-37-32॥

translations.english: The monkeys also collected finesmelling flowers from the sacrificial altar to please Sugriva with.
